mapper.select: SELECT b.*, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.available_qty), 0) as available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_qty), 0) as total_qty FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON b.id = s.book_id WHERE b.id = #{id} GROUP BY b.id

SELECT b.*, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.available_qty), 0) as available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_qty), 0) as total_qty FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON b.id = s.book_id
b.status = 1
AND b.status = #{status}
AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{author}, '%')
AND b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{isbn}, '%')
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}
GROUP BY b.id ORDER BY b.id DESC

SELECT b.*, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(MAX(s.available_qty), 0) as available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_qty), 0) as total_qty, COUNT(br.id) as borrow_count FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON b.id = s.book_id LEFT JOIN borrow_record br ON b.id = br.book_id WHERE b.status = 1 GROUP BY b.id, c.name ORDER BY borrow_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT b.*, c.name as category_name, COALESCE(MAX(s.available_qty), 0) as available_qty, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_qty), 0) as total_qty FROM book b LEFT JOIN category c ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN stock s ON b.id = s.book_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT bk.category_id FROM borrow_record br INNER JOIN book bk ON br.book_id = bk.id WHERE br.teacher_id = #{teacherId} ) user_cats ON b.category_id = user_cats.category_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_record WHERE teacher_id = #{teacherId} ) borrowed ON b.id = borrowed.book_id WHERE b.status = 1 AND borrowed.book_id IS NULL GROUP BY b.id, c.name ORDER BY b.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.id) FROM book b
b.status = 1

AND b.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND b.author LIKE CONCAT('%', #{author}, '%')
AND b.isbn LIKE CONCAT('%', #{isbn}, '%')
AND b.category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO book (isbn, title, author, publisher, publish_date, price, summary, category_id, status) VALUES (#{isbn}, #{title}, #{author}, #{publisher}, #{publishDate}, #{price}, #{summary}, #{categoryId}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE book SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: UPDATE book SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
